{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distribution of channels and customer_segment
print("Channel distribution:")
print(df['channel'].value_counts())

print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check if there's a systematic imbalance in customer_segment between channels
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])
print(cross_tab)

# Compute conversion rates by channel
conversion_rates = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rates by channel:")
print(conversion_rates)

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']
print(f"\nDifference (email - paid_search): {difference}")"}
